Definition: to jump, i.e. be violently agitated; causatively, to terrify, shake off, untie
BiblicalUsage: 1) to start up, tremble, shake, spring up; 1a) (Qal) to start up; 1b) (Piel) to leap; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to start up; 2) to loose, let loose, undo, be free, be loose; 2a) (Hiphil); 2a1) to unfasten, loosen; 2a2) to set free, unbind
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
